warrior.name: Berserker
warrior.description: Two-handed glass cannon. Pile STR for raw damage and just enough CON to outlast the second pack. INT untouched. Whirlwind clears trash, Battle Cry covers the back rank.

warrior.name: Guardian
warrior.description: Sword-and-board frontline tank. CON majority so HP can soak hits; STR for shield bash damage. Unbreakable + Battle Cry keep the team alive.

fighter.name: Execution (2H)
fighter.description: Two-handed precision damage. STR-heavy, modest CON, no INT. Sunder Armor → Precise Strike combo deletes priority targets.

fighter.name: Frenzy (Dual)
fighter.description: Dual-wielding blender. DEX matters as much as STR for the rapid-strike cadence. Riposte counters when low. INT untouched.

fighter.name: Protector
fighter.description: One-hand + shield wall. CON-led tank with enough STR for Riposte counters. Defensive Stance up at all times.

paladin.name: Holy Warrior
paladin.description: STR-led smiter. Holy Strike resolves to heavy-mode with a sword/hammer; Lay on Hands keeps the party up. Some CON for survivability.

paladin.name: Lightbringer
paladin.description: INT-led caster paladin. Holy Strike resolves to magic-mode with a scepter; Consecration zone-locks packs. Spell power scales the kit.

ranger.name: Sharpshooter
ranger.description: DEX-stacked single-target. Aimed Shot melts a priority enemy each round; Smoke Trap covers retreat.

ranger.name: Volley
ranger.description: AoE rain-of-arrows ranger. DEX still primary but more CON to survive the long fights. Rain of Arrows + Multi Shot trash clear.

rogue.name: Assassin
rogue.description: Backstab + Death Mark burst. DEX dominant, low CON. Poison Blade extends the kill window.

rogue.name: Saboteur
rogue.description: Survival-biased rogue. DEX still primary for hits, but CON climbs so Shadow Step gets you out alive. Poison Blade + Death Mark do the damage over time so you never need to stay in melee long.

mage.name: Evoker
mage.description: INT-stacked nuker. Fireball + Meteor; CON only enough to survive incidental hits. Spell power compounds via gear affixes.

mage.name: Arcanist
mage.description: Hardened caster build. INT still leads but CON climbs so the glass cannon stops being glass. Blizzard slows incoming damage, Arcane Surge bursts when needed.

cleric.name: Shepherd
cleric.description: Heal-first cleric. INT majority for Mass Resurrection scaling, CON for survivability. Sanctuary covers a fragile caster.

cleric.name: Warpriest
cleric.description: Tank-leaning cleric. CON tops the spread so the healer is also the rock. Smite and Sanctuary keep the line stable; Heal still comes through INT-scaling gear.

bard.name: Flair
bard.description: Builds Flair stacks then unloads. Hybrid DEX/INT split per Bard kit; some CON.

bard.name: Troubadour
bard.description: Stoic bard. CON-led so the song never stops — survives every fight. Ballad of Valor and Inspiring Tune for party support; damage is incidental.

druid.name: Wildshape
druid.description: INT-led druid focused on long-fight value via Forest Wolf summon and Rejuvenation.

druid.name: Oakheart
druid.description: Bear-form druid. CON-led so Wild Shape gives raw HP rather than damage. Entangle locks the field down while Rejuvenation drips healing through to allies.

necromancer.name: Lich Lord
necromancer.description: INT pump for Death Coil + Skeletal Servant; CON sustains the long mana wars.

necromancer.name: Graveward
necromancer.description: Life-drain necromancer. CON-heavy so Life Drain keeps regenerating into a bigger pool. Skeletons soak the front; the necromancer outlasts everyone.

warlock.name: Dark Pact
warlock.description: INT-led warlock; Bound Imp summons a damage pet, Curse softens priority targets.

warlock.name: Soulbinder
warlock.description: Hardened warlock. CON climbs so Soul Pact's HP cost doesn't fold the build. Corruption + Void Rift do persistent DoT damage instead of burst.

demon_hunter.name: Bowhunter
demon_hunter.description: DEX-led with a bow. Demon Bolt resolves to light-mode. Anti-demon talents shine in Acts 3+.

demon_hunter.name: Channeler
demon_hunter.description: INT-led with a wand. Demon Bolt resolves to magic-mode; spell power scales through gear.

dragon_knight.name: Wyrmblade
dragon_knight.description: STR-led with a great-axe. Dragon Claw resolves to heavy-mode; Dragon Scales tanks.

dragon_knight.name: Breathcaller
dragon_knight.description: INT-tilted hybrid. Breath Weapon resolves to magic-mode with a scepter; STR still scales the melee floor.

pyromancer.name: Inferno
pyromancer.description: Pure INT burn-it-down. Fireball every turn; Burn Aura ticks the row.

pyromancer.name: Cinderward
pyromancer.description: Resilient pyromancer. CON tops the budget so you live long enough for Meteor to come up. Ignite stacks while Burn Aura ticks down the back rank.

stormcaller.name: Thunderhead
stormcaller.description: INT chain-lightning specialist. CON enough to survive between casts.

stormcaller.name: Stormwarden
stormcaller.description: Tank-leaning stormcaller. Thunder Ring zones the battlefield and CON lets you stand in your own storms. Less burst, far more longevity.

oracle.name: Foresight
oracle.description: Support oracle. INT for utility scaling; CON for survivability.

oracle.name: Sentinel
oracle.description: Bulwark oracle. CON-led so Foresight shields hold up and Ascendance can land before you fall. Prophecy plus a heavy buffer.

swashbuckler.name: Duelist
swashbuckler.description: DEX-led parry-counter. Riposte counters keep enemies on tilt.

swashbuckler.name: Showman
swashbuckler.description: Taunt-bait swashbuckler. DEX still primary but CON climbs so Taunt actually draws aggro and survives it. Flourish builds Flair while you wear them down.

scavenger.name: Opportunist
scavenger.description: DEX-led scrounger. Scrounge between fights, kit-shot at range.

scavenger.name: Pack Rat
scavenger.description: Durable scavenger. CON-led so you survive long enough for Big Score to come up. Makeshift Bomb and Thrown Junk pull damage while you scavenge.

tactician.name: Commander
tactician.description: DEX/INT split. Buffs the party rather than dealing personal damage.

tactician.name: Warden
tactician.description: CON-led tactician. Shield Wall plus rally cadence — you stay on the line, the party orbits around you. INT still scales the orders.

chronomancer.name: Temporal
chronomancer.description: INT-led time mage. Time Stop windows let the party stack damage.

chronomancer.name: Horologist
chronomancer.description: Support chronomancer. CON-led so Rewind never finds you dead. Haste and Slow Time keep the tempo in your favour without spiking burst.

monk.name: Ascetic
monk.description: DEX flurry. CON moderate so the unarmed front line doesn't fold.

monk.name: Iron Palm
monk.description: Body-of-stone monk. CON-led so Inner Focus self-heals a much larger pool. Palm Strike + Flurry deliver damage while you absorb the front.

knight.name: Protector
knight.description: CON-led tank. Shield Bash + Taunt + Holy Strike. Sword and shield always.

knight.name: Crusader
knight.description: STR-tilted DPS knight. Holy Strike is the win-con.

sorcerer.name: Wild Chaos
sorcerer.description: INT-stacked sorcerer. Wild Bolt every turn, Arcane Surge for windows.

sorcerer.name: Mana Warden
sorcerer.description: Chaos-warded sorcerer. CON bulks up so Mana Burn doesn't backfire and Chaos Ward saves your life when the dice go bad.

shaman.name: Spiritcaller
shaman.description: INT-led with totem support. Spirit Bolt damage, Healing Totem keeps party up.

shaman.name: Totemguard
shaman.description: Anvil shaman. CON-tilted so Ancestral Shield holds and you live to keep the totems planted. Healing Totem ticks while you absorb hits.

witch_hunter.name: Inquisitor
witch_hunter.description: STR/DEX hybrid. Pistol + blade. Anti-magic talents.

witch_hunter.name: Templar
witch_hunter.description: Heavy witch hunter. CON-led so Purge Strike connects safely from melee. Inquisitor Mark sets priority targets while you weather the answer.

runesmith.name: Forgewright
runesmith.description: STR rune-warrior. Heavy weapon + rune-empowered strikes. Runes scale with INT secondary.

runesmith.name: Wardsmith
runesmith.description: Tank runesmith. CON tops the spread; STR still scales the hammer. Rune of Warding pre-shields the party while Forge Flame counterattacks.

shadow_dancer.name: Umbral
shadow_dancer.description: DEX shadow-step rogue with stealth utility.

shadow_dancer.name: Nightveil
shadow_dancer.description: Evasion-heavy shadow dancer. DEX still leads but CON climbs so Smoke Veil and Dance of Blades buy you real survivability, not just escape velocity.

tinker.name: Gadgeteer
tinker.description: INT-led tinker. Clockwork Bolt + grenades. Quick-Fix keeps the party patched.

tinker.name: Mechwright
tinker.description: Durable tinker. CON-tilted so Quick-Fix has someone to land on between volleys. Overcharge supports the party while you weather threats.

enchanter.name: Mind Weaver
enchanter.description: INT enchanter. Sleep + Charm crowd-control; Arcane Jolt finishes sleeping targets.

enchanter.name: Beguiler
enchanter.description: Resilient enchanter. CON climbs so a missed Sleep doesn't end the fight. Mind Charm pulls aggro off the casters; Arcane Jolt finishes priority targets.

priest.name: Dusk Vigil
priest.description: INT priest balancing heals + shadow. Mend keeps the party up; Shadow Bolt does the killing.

priest.name: Lightkeeper
priest.description: Front-line priest. CON-led so Mend keeps the line standing and Call Back has someone left to revive. Shadow Veil for emergencies; damage is incidental.
